'''Nilo''', designated '''RC-1570''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] of the elite [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commando squad known as [[Tark Squad]], which was part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Nilo was nicknamed by his genetic template and trainer [[Sarsius Torne]] after the [[Thyrsian (language)|Thyrsian letter]] for zero.

==Biography==
RC-1570, who adopted the name Nilo, was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Tark Squad]]. In actuality, Captain Nilo and his squad were [[Thyrsian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] trained by Sarsius Torne of the [[Sun Guard]]s to infiltrate the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as part of a deal made with [[Zeta Magnus]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to recover [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. To ensure obedience Nilo was implanted with a cybernetic control band. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Captain Nilo and his squad were sent to assist [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in liberating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye]] from Zeta Magnus while being disguised as a relief team.

Captain Nilo and the rest of the liberation team snuck into [[Kharys' fortress|Zeta Magnus' fortress]] through [[Entyrmion]]'s subterranean tunnel system located beneath the fortress. While in the cave, the liberation team was attacked by multiple [[Oskan blood eater]]s created by Zeta Magnus which killed many of their [[S'kytri]] guides as well as the [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the S'Kytri [[Highland Clans]], Lord [[Klarymére]]. Nilo killed the blood eaters with a [[Class-D detonator]] which angered Obi-Wan, as he believed it was ''"affront to the force"''. When the liberation team arrived in Zeta Magnus' fortress, Nilo and the rest of Tark Squad led the [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] into a field of [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]s that magnetised his Jedi Commanders to the ground. Nilo and his squad revealed to the Jedi Commanders that they were allied with Zeta Magnus and left them to be [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by Zeta Magnus and his [[Blue-Tark/Legends|torture droid]]. Nilo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fortress when he was vaporised by a [[Class-D annihilation|Class-D detonator]] used by Jedi Commanders Anakin Skywalker and [[Halagad Ventor]] after he and his squad attempted to betray them.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Our armor is environmentally controlled, General.|Nilo, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn Armor]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Nilo wore specialised silver [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] to distinguish himself from the rest of his squad. Nilo used a [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] interchangeable rifle, he was also equipped with Class-D detonators which were supposed to be outlawed under galactic law.

==Behind the scenes==
Nilo shares his name with [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], creator of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] concept art<ref name="Shades">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/bts/design/f20000313/index.html|text=Shades of Blue and Red}}</ref> from which Zeta Magnus' appearance was drawn.<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />
